map.根据权利受到侵害或知道权利受损的日期，计算诉讼时效届满日，提示剩余可主张权利的时: Computes the expiry date of the limitation period from the date the right was infringed or the date the infringement became known, and shows how much time remains to assert the right.
map.📖 查看「诉讼时效计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the guide to statute of limitations calculation
map.存在时效中止情形: Suspension of the limitation period applies
map.存在时效中断情形: Interruption of the limitation period applies
map.普通时效：权利受侵害 / 知道之日 2021-01-01，普通诉讼时效 3 年，: Ordinary period: the date of infringement or of becoming aware is 2021-01-01, the ordinary limitation period is 3 years, expiring 2024-01-01.
map.时效中断：起算 2020-06-01，2022-06-01 提起诉讼中断，自中断: Interruption: starting 2020-06-01, filing suit on 2022-06-01 interrupts the period; 3 years run again from the interruption date, expiring 2025-06-01.
map.时效中止：起算 2021-01-01（届满 2024-01-01），2023-1: Suspension: starting 2021-01-01 (expiring 2024-01-01), force majeure occurs on 2023-10-01 and the obstacle is removed on 2024-02-01, suspending 123 days, so expiry is postponed to 2024-05-03.
map.算例：3 年普通时效与中止: Worked example: the 3-year ordinary period and suspension
map.起算日 2021-01-01，普通 3 年 → 届满 2024-01-01。若在: Start date 2021-01-01, ordinary 3 years → expiry 2024-01-01. If force majeure occurs within the final 6 months (2023-10-01) and is removed on 2024-02-01, the suspended days = 2024-02-01 − 2023-10-01 = 123 days, and expiry is postponed to 2024-01-01 + 123 days = 2024-05-03. In the interruption case, 3 years run again from the interruption date (for example 2022-06-01).
map.时效中断与中止有何区别？: What is the difference between interruption and suspension?
map.中断因起诉、一方提出要求或同意履行而发生，从中断时起重新计算；中止因不可抗力等障: Interruption arises from filing suit, from one party making a demand, or from agreeing to perform, and the period starts running again from that moment; suspension arises when an obstacle such as force majeure occurs within the final 6 months, and the period expires 6 months after the obstacle is removed (this tool approximates it by postponing by the number of suspended days).
map.最长 20 年保护期如何起算？: How is the maximum 20-year protection period counted?
map.自权利受到损害之日起算，不适用“知道或应当知道”规则；超过 20 年法院不予保护: It runs from the date the right was damaged and does not apply the knew or should have known rule; courts do not protect rights beyond 20 years, although an extension may be applied for in special circumstances.
